title: Advanced Face Biometric System
description: Enterprise-grade real-time biometric platform featuring face recognition, 7-class emotion analysis, liveness detection, and full audit logging. Consent-first architecture with AI-generated emotion-aware quotes powered by Gemini API.
longDescription: Built to production-grade standards with enterprise security principles. The system supports multi-user enrollment, role-based access, and real-time monitoring dashboards.

title: Hand Gesture & ISL Recognition
description: L4 enterprise-grade platform combining custom hand gesture recognition with Indian Sign Language detection. 2,500+ lines across 10 modular components with Singleton, Factory, Observer, and MVC design patterns.
longDescription: Designed with accessibility as the core mission. Supports real-time ISL translation with a 90%+ recognition accuracy across 26 alphabets and 100+ common phrases.

title: AI Road Safety Intelligence System
description: Full-stack platform automating road safety audit analysis. NLP extraction, IRC clause mapping via TF-IDF, SOR/CPWD/GeM cost estimation, RAG-based AI chatbot. 🥈 2nd Place Nationally at IIT Madras CoERS 2025.
longDescription: Won 2nd place nationally in a ₹90K prize pool organized by IIT Madras' MoRTH-funded Centre of Excellence for Road Safety. Built with a 4-person team in 36 hours.

title: Shakti — AI Educational Chatbot
description: Multilingual AI chatbot supporting 10 languages with dual text/voice interaction. Covers Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Math — with dynamic quizzes and personalized roadmaps.
longDescription: Powered by NLP and speech recognition for voice input/output. Designed for students in rural India who speak regional languages.

title: Chemical Buddy
description: AI chemistry study assistant with PDF document analysis, natural language Q&A, unit conversion. Built on LangChain, FAISS vector search, and Google Generative AI.
longDescription: 10th place at InnovateK12 Hackathon. Supports any chemistry PDF as a knowledge base with semantic search powered by FAISS.

title: Trade Insights Bot — Ultimate Edition
description: Multi-agent AI trading assistant with real-time insights, portfolio analytics (Sharpe, Volatility, Drawdown), news sentiment via DuckDuckGo, LLM-powered strategy backtesting. Mixtral-8x7B.
longDescription: Side-by-side strategy comparison with live charting. Supports paper trading simulation and strategy scoring. Uses Together API for inference.

title: AI Coding Assistant — VS Code Extension
description: VS Code extension delivering AI-powered real-time code autocompletion and natural language code summarization via Gemini API integrated directly into the developer workflow.
longDescription: Available as a .vsix package. Provides context-aware completions that understand the entire file, not just the current line.

title: Weather App with Kubernetes
description: Flask-based weather app containerized with Docker and orchestrated via Kubernetes with production-grade deployment configuration.
longDescription: Includes Helm charts, rolling update strategy, and horizontal pod autoscaling configuration.

title: MNIST Handwritten Classification
description: Classical ML and deep learning models on MNIST dataset for handwritten digit recognition. Comparative study of CNN architectures.
longDescription: Benchmarked 5 models: Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, CNN, and ResNet. Full analysis in Jupyter notebook.
